I'll push a commit with your requested changes shortly after. Please note there might be a delay between these steps, but rest assured I'm on the job!

For more direct control, you can switch me to **Reactive Mode**. When this mode is on, I will only act on comments where you specifically mention me with `@jules`. reviews.body:
## Pull request overview

Adds Vitest unit coverage for the frontend Tauri IPC wrapper layer (`src/lib/backend/*`) to validate that wrapper functions pass the correct command names and payloads into `safeInvoke`, and records the coverage expansion in the Sonar journal.

**Changes:**
- Added new unit test suites for backend wrappers: utils, agent-commands, builtin-tools, browser, and file-operations.
- Standardized tests around mocking `safeInvoke` to avoid real Tauri IPC execution.
- Appended a new coverage expansion entry to `.jules/sonar.md`.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 6 out of 6 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| src/lib/backend/utils.test.ts | Tests wrapper parameter/return passthrough for log ops, URL open, downloads, service context, and misc commands. |
| src/lib/backend/file-operations.test.ts | Tests dropped-file and filesystem wrapper command mappings. |
| src/lib/backend/builtin-tools.test.ts | Tests builtin server/tool listing wrapper command mappings (with/without serverName). |
| src/lib/backend/browser.test.ts | Tests browser session/navigation wrapper command mappings. |
| src/lib/backend/agent-commands.test.ts | Tests agent IPC wrapper calls plus UI tool-call message synthesis behavior. |
| .jules/sonar.md | Records the coverage expansion in the Sonar journal. |
</details>
